verdict.rationale: JumpCloud ships native, same-platform MDM/UEM (docs-8, docs-22) covering Windows/Linux/macOS/iOS/Android, tied directly to its identity directory (docs-12, docs-26), and community users corroborate using JumpCloud's MDM+SSO as a single pane of glass (jumpcloud-comm-2). However, the evidence never explicitly documents remote lock/wipe functionality or granular policy-enforcement mechanics, only general 'manage, configure, secure' language, and conditional-access docs speak to access revocation rather than device wipe. Missing for 10: explicit remote lock/wipe documentation, detailed enrollment workflow specifics, and independent corroboration of policy enforcement granularity.
